profile.headline: Software Engineer Extraordinaire
profile.summary: As a Software Engineer, Innovator, and Creator, I intend to change the ways computers are used.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Modules Team for AWS Redis/Valkey Elasticache.
Features included JSON Module, Vector Similarity Search Module.
Provided ongoing development for new module capabilities and integrations with other AWS Services.
Wrote internal tools to aggregate customer metrics. Improving operations for direct team and greater AWS Team.
Helped start Boston Office for Modules team as the second person on the team. Provided ongoing mentoring and technical leadership.
Collaborated across timezones within the United States and abroad.
Now working on enhanced features for Elastic File System.
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · C++ · Software Engineering · Software Project Management · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed internal tools using Python and Google-specific languages to run automated unit tests on Google Borg and generate statistics analyzing tens of thousands of queries daily from Google Flights' QPX engine. Deployed and maintained infrastructure for running and reporting on said tools. Collaborated with Google Flights developers to address issues discovered.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Python (Programming Language) · Java · C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed tools for Pega's enterprise application platform using a combination of Java, Javascript, HTML, and Pega proprietary components. Communicated with customers to develop hotfixes for urgent issues.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Develop the client for an internal C++/C# application used for testing by the Office division of Microsoft. Work with testers to determine what features are in need of development or improvement.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed an internal C#/ASP.NET application for Intel to use to keep track of silicon inventory, manage wafer route requirements, and generate orders for more materials. Trained teams of workers to use the new software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed comprehensive XML Schemas for the integration of multiple formerly incompatible military standards. Integrated these schemas into a Java framework.

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description:
Took down Food Moocher after migrating servers.

Previous description:

Food Moocher is a community of users dedicated to finding and sharing free food events. Every day is a new chance to find opportunities near you!

Food Moocher can be found at www.FoodMoocher.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Integrated the framework of a social gaming company with the Facebook API in order to create a Facebook application. Designed a badge reward structure for the company's game.
